messages.subject: Re: joining the dashboard layout with tab panels
parts:
I have a small demo of a tabpanel containing a grid at:

spark.rstudio.com/johnharrison/appY/

The idea is to have two apps X and Y. appX is a normal gridster type app for example:

global.R:

library(shinyGridster)

ui.R:

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  gridster(width = 50, height = 50, marginy = 14, marginx = 10,
           gridsterItem(col = 1, row = 1, sizex = 2, sizey = 5,
                        htmlOutput('idA')
                   ),
           gridsterItem(col = 3, row = 1, sizex = 3, sizey = 5,
                        htmlOutput('idB')
           ),
           gridsterItem(col = 6, row = 1, sizex = 3, sizey = 5,
                        htmlOutput('idC')
           )
          
  ),
 
  tags$head(
    tags$link(rel = 'stylesheet', type = 'text/css', href = 'styles.css'),
    tags$title("Amazing AppX")
  )
 
)
       
)

server.R:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

})

www/styles.css:

.gridster .gs_w {
  background-color: #F5F5F5;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.gridster .gs_w.alert {
  color: #FFF;
}

.gridster .gs_w.warning {
  background-color: #fc6;
  color: #FFF;
}


This appX can be seen at

spark.rstudio.com/johnharrison/appX/

Its a simple gridster app with some styling so that the panels are not white by default.

The second app Y is a pageWithSidebar

ui.R:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Hello Shiny!"),
 
  # Sidebar with a slider input
  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput("obs",
                "Number of observations:",
                min = 0,
                max = 1000,
                value = 500)
  ),
 
  # Show a plot of the generated distribution
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Gridster",
               tags$iframe(src = "../appX", style = "width: 90%; height: 500px")
               ),
      tabPanel("Another", verbatimTextOutput("summary"))
    )
  )
))

server.R:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
 
})


It includes the first app X using an iframe.
